meta.title: Features — ExperimentLens
meta.description: Every capability available in ExperimentLens — for agents & LLMs (traces, judges, verdicts, session comparison) and for ML experiments (parallel-coordinates analysis, comparative views, explainability, workflow drill-down).
meta.ogDescription: The full feature set of ExperimentLens — observability & explainability for agents, LLMs and ML experiments.

hero.title: The full feature set of ExperimentLens.
hero.subtitle: ExperimentLens is the visualization layer on top of your agent stack, tracking server and execution engine. It makes every trace, verdict, metric, parameter and artifact you capture explorable, comparable and explainable.

showcase.title: What you can do in ExperimentLens.
showcase.subtitle: Every run links to its traces — explorable down to a single LLM call.

features.title: Every configuration becomes a session.
features.body: Sessions get their own dedicated page: one row per session with every parameter and metric as a column, and a parallel-coordinates plot linked live to the table underneath — so you can see which settings actually move the metric you care about.
bullets: Dedicated Sessions page
One row per session, every logged parameter and metric as a column
Parallel coordinates plot linked live to the session table

features.title: A dashboard for sessions, traces, tokens, cost and quality.
features.body: The Overview page opens on stat tiles and trend graphs — sessions, traces, latency, tokens, cost and judge pass rate — with a Detect issues panel that runs an LLM scan across a session's traces on demand and surfaces problems before you go looking for them.
bullets: Trend charts for trace volume, latency and tokens per trace
Roll-up stat tiles across sessions, traces, cost and errors
One-click LLM scan that flags problem traces

features.title: Follow every span from retrieval to answer.
features.body: Surfaces each observation — retrieval steps, LLM calls and judge evaluations — as part of a connected trace. Inspect inputs, outputs, latency, tokens and cost per step, or open the graph view to see the whole run at once.
bullets: Spans, generations, retrievers & events per trace
Per-observation latency, tokens and cost
List and graph views of the full trace

features.title: Judges and checks on every answer.
features.body: Each trace is evaluated across LLM-as-judge dimensions and deterministic checks, with the results rolled up into a single pass rate. Read the rationale behind every verdict — including why a check failed.
bullets: Correctness, groundedness, relevance, completeness & conciseness judges
Deterministic checks: citation validity, exact match, keyword presence, latency
Per-check rationale and an overall pass rate

features.title: Compare configurations side by side.
features.body: Select any subset of sessions and switch between summary, timeline, verdicts, responses, graph and human annotations.
bullets: Mosaic & stacked summaries for latency, tokens and pass rate
Verdict diff that flags each regression and fix, with rationale
Response diff and human annotations, side by side across sessions

features.title: Verdict pass rates and score distributions, per experiment.
features.body: The Overview page's Quality tab rolls every judge and check into pass-rate charts, then lets you drill into the full score distribution for each metric and check.
bullets: Verdict pass rates across every judge dimension
Full score distributions for every metric and check
Session, trace, token, cost and error roll-ups alongside the charts

features.title: See which agent step is the bottleneck.
features.body: Per-agent latency and call frequency breakdowns separate the retriever, generator and judges, so you can tell where time and tokens actually go before you optimize.
bullets: Per-agent average latency by span type
Call frequency per agent across the session
Break down costs across retrievers, generators and judges

deep.title: The complete agent and LLM feature set.
deep.subtitle: Everything ExperimentLens ships for agents and LLM apps, at a glance.

items.title: Trace ingestion
items.body: Every run links to one or more traces — spans, generations, retrievers and events.

items.title: Overview dashboard
items.body: The Overview tab opens on stat tiles and trend graphs — sessions, traces, latency, tokens, cost and judge pass rate — across Usage, Quality and Agents sub-views.

items.title: Sessions tab
items.body: Sessions get their own tab: one row per session with every logged parameter and metric, plus the parallel-coordinates plot linked to the table.

items.title: Traces tab
items.body: A dedicated Traces tab lists every trace across sessions, so you can search and filter without drilling in through a session first.

items.title: Automated trace scanning
items.body: Run an LLM scan across a session's traces straight from the Overview dashboard's Detect issues panel — it flags errors and low-quality or off-track answers before you go looking for them.

items.title: LLM-as-judge verdicts
items.body: Define your own judges when setting up the experiment and receive pass/fail verdicts with written rationale.

items.title: Deterministic checks
items.body: Configure citation validity, exact match, keyword presence, latency checks, retrieval hit/recall and more for your experiment — scored automatically once defined.

items.title: Verdict diff
items.body: A per-question grid across runs that flags regressions and fixes between judge and check outcomes.

items.title: Per-agent performance
items.body: Latency and call-frequency breakdowns per agent step, plus session-level P95, tokens and cost.

items.title: Token & cost tracking
items.body: Prompt and completion tokens with cost aggregated per observation, per trace, per session and per experiment.

items.title: Question & answer view
items.body: Read the full model answer with citations alongside the judge verdicts for that trace.

items.title: Conversation replay
items.body: Edit a prompt on any observation and re-run the exact same call to compare outputs in place.

items.title: Human annotations
items.body: Rate and leave free-text notes directly on a trace or an individual span, capturing human evaluation alongside the automated judges and checks.

items.title: Counterfactual prompt attribution
items.body: Instantly see which parts of your input the LLM actually relied on to produce its answer.

items.title: Counterfactual verification
items.body: Remove the LLM's top-cited source and confirm the answer actually depended on it, catching RAG answers that only look well-sourced.

showcase.title: What you can do in ExperimentLens.

features.title: Find the configuration that actually moves the metric.
features.body: Plot hundreds of runs on a single linked parallel-coordinates view. Brush an axis and watch the table filter in real time. Group by any hyperparameter, color by any metric — and see which choices matter before you launch another sweep.
bullets: Multi-axis parallel coordinates with live brushing
Group, color and filter by any logged parameter
Bidirectional sync between chart and run table

features.title: Compare runs side by side across metrics, models and data.
features.body: Select any subset of runs and switch between Metrics, Models and Data tabs. Mosaic and stacked layouts let you spot regressions and tradeoffs in the metrics you logged.
bullets: Mosaic & stacked metric layouts
Cross-run model & dataset diffs
Status-aware comparison (completed/scheduled)

features.title: From monitoring to steering.
features.body: Monitor and steer pipeline executions at runtime, guided by intermediate results and visual feedback. Use diagnostic views to adjust configuration choices and re-launch modified pipelines.
bullets: Monitor and steer pipeline executions at runtime
Guided by intermediate results and visual feedback
Adjust configuration choices and re-launch modified pipelines

features.title: PDP, ALE and feature importance — wired to your runs.
features.body: Open the Explainability tab to see global post-hoc explanations attached to the same experiment context. No notebooks, no glue code.
bullets: Feature importance per variability point
Partial Dependence Plots (PDP)
Accumulated Local Effects (ALE) & counterfactuals

features.title: Drill into a single workflow's parameters, metrics & artifacts.
features.body: Inspect the exact parameters, metrics and artifacts that the run logged to the tracking server. Use ratings and status to curate the runs that matter.
bullets: Parameters, metrics & artifacts pane
Run ratings & status
Direct link from any comparative view
